<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914213_theRebbe_9" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914213_theRebbe_9__p007">
  <section v="18">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the sequence from Rosh Hashanah through Sukkos, culminating in the future redemption and the universal service of G-d.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">9)</t>
    <t s="1">7)</t>
    <t s="2">And this is the meaning of what is said, "In sukkos you shall dwell for seven days; every citizen in Israel shall dwell in sukkos,"</t>
    <t s="3">that after the service of "Blow the shofar in the month" on Rosh Hashanah,</t>
    <t s="4">when the drawing down is still in a manner of "in concealment,"</t>
    <t s="5">behold, after this come the ten days between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur, about which it is said,</t>
    <t s="6">"Seek G-d when He is found, call Him when He is near,"</t>
    <t s="7">and the saying of the Holy One, blessed be He, is considered an action,</t>
    <t s="8">and it becomes an action in actuality,</t>
    <t s="9">that "seek" and "call Him" are actualized in deed.</t>
    <t s="10">And this then effects the four days between Yom Kippur and Sukkos,</t>
    <t s="11">when the Torah of truth testifies that all of Israel and every individual Jew are occupied with mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="12">and after the preparation</t>
    <t s="13">(during these four days)</t>
    <t s="14">of "the festival of Sukkos you shall make for yourself" etc.</t>
    <t s="15">(with all the interpretations thereof)</t>
    <t s="16">[that even the making of the sukkah is included in the mitzvah,</t>
    <t s="17">as the Alter Rebbe writes in his Shulchan Aruch</t>
    <t s="18">to rule halachically regarding the reason for the ruling that we do not recite a blessing over its making because it is not the completion of the mitzvah,</t>
    <t s="19">and the blessing of Shehecheyanu also applies to the making]</t>
    <t s="20">behold, they then come on the festival of Sukkos to the fulfillment of the mitzvah itself,</t>
    <t s="21">"In sukkos you shall dwell for seven days."</t>
    <t s="22">And immediately the next morning</t>
    <t s="23">(at dawn and sunrise)</t>
    <t s="24">comes the mitzvah of the Four Species,</t>
    <t s="25">"And you shall take for yourselves on the first day the fruit of a beautiful tree, branches of date palms, and a branch of a leafy tree, and willows of the brook, and you shall rejoice before the L-rd your G-d."</t>
    <t s="26">Until they come to the Simchas Beis HaShoevah,</t>
    <t s="27">where the great joy of "and you shall rejoice" occurs in a manner of "whoever has not seen the Simchas Beis HaShoevah has never seen joy in his life."</t>
    <t s="28">And then they merit that very soon, "every citizen in Israel shall dwell in sukkos" will actually be fulfilled</t>
    <t s="29">(and not merely that they are fit to dwell),</t>
    <t s="30">for the true and complete redemption will come through our righteous Mashiach.</t>
    <t s="31">And then the fulfillment of the mitzvah of "and you shall rejoice before the L-rd your G-d" will be in completeness and from the Torah,</t>
    <t s="32">its fulfillment being in the Beis HaMikdash,</t>
    <t s="33">the third Beis HaMikdash,</t>
    <t s="34">"The Sanctuary, O L-rd, which Your hands have established,"</t>
    <t s="35">very soon.</t>
    <t s="36">He will come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,</t>
    <t s="37">and build the Beis HaMikdash in its place,</t>
    <t s="38">and gather the dispersed of Israel, and the kingdom shall be the L-rd's.</t>
    <t s="39">And as an introduction to this, it will be as it is said,</t>
    <t s="40">"For then I will turn to the peoples a pure language, etc., to serve Him with one accord,"</t>
    <t s="41">which is drawn down in revelation through the offering of the seventy bulls on the festival of Sukkos.</t>
    <t s="42">May it be so for us,</t>
    <t s="43">and very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
